verdict.rationale: MX documents retrieving transaction data for connected accounts and states the history depth: 90 days with Account Aggregation and up to 24 months with Extended Transaction History. It also documents automatic re-aggregation about every 24 hours, webhooks for event subscriptions, and a published OpenAPI spec for the Platform API. Nothing in the evidence describes pagination of transaction endpoints or a pattern for fetching only changed transactions; webhooks and daily aggregation only imply one. Missing for 10: documented pagination on transaction list endpoints, an explicit delta/incremental sync pattern (e.g., updated-since filters or transaction-change webhooks), independent or hands-on corroboration.
